title: Mike McConnell as Dan Burisch's godfather

tellings.quote: There's some weird stories around Dan Barish where I think his like godfather was Mike McConnell

plain: Mike McConnell, a former top US intelligence official, is said to have been the godfather of Dan Burisch, a man known for claims about secret alien-related research. Michels mentions this as one of several odd stories around Burisch, passing on what he has heard, including from Brian Jackson, and it would link Burisch to the highest levels of intelligence.
